## Questions related to keywords at SEOwind [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/questions-to-answer/\#0-toc-title)

SEOwind analyzes and provides you with commonly searched questions. This way you can understand what kind of content your audience is looking for and is interested in. From the section Questions To Answer, you can go deeper into

- Questions from Google (People Also Ask),
- Quora, and
- Reddit.

![seowind questions to answer](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Questions-to-Answer-1024x552.png)

Often those places have not only valuable questions but also answers. This is a great opportunity to enrich your content with some subject matter expertise feed.

These can be used in the Frequently Asked Questions Section as well as a part of your core outline and [headings](https://seowind.io/blog-headings/). The decision is up to you.

## Why it is valuable to include questions people ask? [\#](https://seowind.io/docs/questions-to-answer/\#1-toc-title)

This is the place where you can get deeper into questions, challenges, issues, and needs your users have. Those insights will let you build additional value for your audience, become more unique and stand out from other pages.

#### Privacy Overview

This website uses cookies to improve your experience while you navigate through the website. Out of these, the cookies that are categorized as necessary are stored on your browser as they are essential for the working of basic functionalities of the website. We also use third-party cookies that help us analyze and understand how you use this website. These cookies will be stored in your browser only with your consent. You also have the option to opt-out of these cookies. But opting out of some of these cookies may affect your browsing experience.
